summary: Raw-event access is not restricted to recorded rollout sources.
failure_scenario: An unrecorded file under Codex home, or a symlink to a file outside it, is returned by /api/event.
fix: Restrict raw-event reads to exact recorded source spans and regular files within resolved rollout directories.

summary: Source identifiers are inserted into HTML attributes without escaping.
failure_scenario: A quote-bearing session, lane, or operation ID injects HTML into the viewer origin.
fix: Escape identifiers in every HTML/SVG attribute and encode URL components.
validation: Frontend source-identifier rendering and URL regression

summary: The local API accepts arbitrary HTTP hosts.
failure_scenario: An attacker-controlled hostname can reach the API in browser configurations allowing DNS rebinding.
fix: Reject unrelated DNS Host headers while supporting loopback, literal IPs, and the configured hostname.
validation: TestHandlerHostPolicy; browser DNS-rebinding exploit not exercised

summary: Index discovery opens nonregular rollout files while holding its lock.
failure_scenario: A FIFO named rollout-*.jsonl blocks scanning and all index readers.
fix: Skip nonregular files before opening discovered rollouts.

summary: Replay heuristics delete genuine short turns.
failure_scenario: A real root turn completing within one second without a timed operation is dropped along with its final answer.
fix: Retain genuine root and child turns; limit replay removal to empty child turns with only injected context.

summary: Recorded conversation text is omitted or truncated.
failure_scenario: Legacy final answers never produce conversation markers; messages over 4000 bytes are clipped before Show all can display them.
fix: Preserve full conversation text and recover legacy/completion final answers with per-turn exact-text deduplication.

summary: The tail reader masks I/O failures as normal EOF.
failure_scenario: A filesystem read failure is treated as successful exhaustion, publishing an incomplete model without an error.
fix: Propagate underlying tail-reader errors instead of returning EOF.

summary: An empty session index violates the API's array contract.
failure_scenario: Summaries serializes nil as null, causing the frontend session-list loader to throw.
fix: Initialize empty summary results as an array and normalize an empty frontend list.

summary: Conversation rendering dereferences optional marker text.
failure_scenario: An empty question or image-only user marker omits text and k.text.length crashes rendering.
fix: Normalize omitted marker text before conversation rendering.

summary: Unchecked thread-ID prefixes panic and create colliding operation IDs.
failure_scenario: Short accepted IDs panic at [:8]; shared prefixes or equal web-search offsets produce conflicting session-wide operation IDs.
fix: Generate operation IDs from a URL-safe full lane namespace and distinct kinds; safely shorten summary titles.

summary: Orphaned turns overwrite their last evidence timestamp.
failure_scenario: The next turn or resumed-session timestamp replaces the previous turn's end, classifying its missing interval as LLM time.
fix: Close orphaned turns at their last evidence before applying the next boundary timestamp.

summary: Live pending operations occupy only one millisecond.
failure_scenario: An open test or worker wait has Start == End, so its ongoing duration is shown as missing telemetry rather than the pending tool phase.
fix: Extend pending tool envelopes to the live turn bound, constrain partition edges, and replace display bounds with recorded completion endpoints.

summary: Retry normalization changes quoted command arguments.
failure_scenario: Distinct quoted test patterns containing > or repeated spaces collapse into the same retry identity.
fix: Use quote-preserving shell tokens for supported normalization and preserve complex syntax verbatim.

summary: Heredoc file data is classified as executed code.
failure_scenario: Writing a Python file containing subprocess.run(['git','push']) is labeled Release although the file is never executed.
fix: Distinguish executable interpreter source from heredoc data while preserving supported write-then-execute and wrapper/pipeline cases.

summary: Asynchronous responses can mutate a newer view.
failure_scenario: Late session, inspector, or poll responses replace current data or write into a different dialog after navigation.
fix: Guard navigation, inspector, refresh, and polling responses by request ownership and the requested session.
validation: Frontend deferred-response, inspector, polling, and pending-navigation regressions
